title: Dormant-role demand rows' no-rng contract is unpinned — the exact invariant that keeps the era-3 re-blessed goldens fold-only
evidence: core/flow.odin:749 `if len(src_ids) > 0 && len(sink_ids) > 0 {` (wraps the only rng draws at :766 `sidx, oks := weighted_pick(&state.rng, e_w[:])` and :774). core/determinism_test.odin:122-126 — the contract exists only as a comment: `// 5.11: the era-3 entries for the class analogues (mirror // demand.json) — email from small_biz, streaming from campus. They // fire only where the new terminal roles exist (empty source sets // skip with no rng draw — the pre-5.11 fixtures' streams are // unchanged by construction).` The sole rng-stream pin is era-0 only — core/demand_test.odin:344-345 `testing.expect(t, state.rng == rng_snapshot, "era 0 must not draw rng (director inactive; legacy demos' rng stream stays put)")`.
detail: qos_manual/qos_emphasis/qos_auto run era 3 with no small_biz/campus nodes; their .t1 deltas are fold-only ONLY because dormant rows draw no rng. That contract is asserted nowhere — only era 0 is pinned. A draw-reordering regression would be silently absorbed by the next re-bless.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test mirroring test_era0_legacy_no_rng_draws at era 3 with a residential-only fixture: snapshot state.rng, step N ticks, expect unchanged rng stream.

title: Fold-only re-bless proof is one-off PR prose, not a durable harness gate — a drifted re-bless passes `harness run`
evidence: harness/main.odin:14 `//   odin run harness -- save [demo...]          re-bless goldens (deliberate; PR-reviewed)` — no fold-verification mode exists. PR body: `- **Fold-only proof (boot):** the new tick-1 state dump under the new code, with the OLD hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40), FNV-hashes to the OLD golden tick-1 **exactly** (\`6c24e9cec592aece\`); the un-spliced dump hashes to the blessed tick-1 (\`ab1fb0d04a90026c\`)` — boot tick-1 only, of 33 demos × 300 ticks. Fold position verified at core/serialize.odin:106-111 (seed8+tick8+rng8+rng8+era1 = 33, then `w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash)`).
detail: I independently re-verified the claims (all 32 logs differ from base at exactly bytes 18-25; splice values match the real goldens) — accurate but manual. Every future catalog change re-relies on prose diligence; no durable check distinguishes fold-only from behavior drift.
recommended_fix: Add a `save --verify-fold-only` mode (or check verb): re-sim under the prior catalog hash and byte-compare state dumps modulo fold bytes 33..40 against pre-save hashes.
